title: Ingest launched application issue events into Vaporize run receipts
createdBy: codex@loom after proving that Vaporize currently launches applications through open without runtime-issue ingestion

historicalContent.description: Create a request-scoped launch envelope that supplies the Vaporize request id and issue-event sink to an installed application, then ingests the resulting events into the run receipt. The current open-based launch is detached and captures no application runtime stream, so lifecycle and collection completion must be explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize creates a unique issue-event sink and request id before launching an instrumented app.
The launched process receives correlation and sink configuration without writing global mutable configuration.
A fixture app reports one recoverable invariant, preserves its containment behavior, and produces one correlated run-receipt event.
The default Apple runtime warning remains active while the structured reporter is installed.
The receipt states whether collection completed, timed out, remained detached, or was not supported by the product.
A run with no issue reports records runtimeIssueExecution as run and unexpectedIssueCount as zero.
A compile-only build records runtimeIssueExecution as not-run and never reuses a prior run's events.
Event artifacts are redacted, bounded, and cleaned or retained according to an explicit receipt policy.
